notes.title: Tobii eye tracking support for Rising Islands
notes.notes:
We're proud to announce that as of now, Rising Islands supports Tobii eye tracking. This technology offers an even better immersive experience.

The features include:

Extended view: Camera shifts depending on where the player is looking
Highlight at gaze: Certain objects light up when looked at
Clean UI: UI is shown when looked at and hidden otherwise
Dash at gaze: Dash towards where the player is looking

Players with a Tobii eye tracker can take advantage of this free update.

notes.title: Rising Islands update 1.013 Patch - #3
notes.notes:
Hello!

I hope that you are all doing great and feeling good. We have been hard at work to improve upon the time trial mode of the game and have restructured it from the ground up under the hood to make it work much smoother. 

For this patch we have also looked at feedback we have received from the community regarding some levels that could be more streamlined with some tweaks.

- Reworked Time trial
- Fixed an iceblock sticking out too much on Slippery Slopes
- Hairo sitting too low in main menu
- General level tweaks
- Minor text fixes

Until next time,

- The Lone Hero Team

notes.title: Post Launch Clean-up
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's been just over a week since launch, and we hope you've all enjoyed all the running, wall running, time-trialing and fun that Rising Islands has to offer! 

We want to thank you all for your support and feedback following the launch, and for all of your help with finding new paths, tricks and both good and bad bugs in the game (although I believe that's called a feature?). We take these very seriously and we are working hard to fix them.
The biggest one that's come to our attention is the issue with the leaderboard. We want you to know that we are aware of this issue, and that we are working on a new system that will replace our current one. It will be better and more stable, but it will take a while longer before it's ready, so please be patient with us until then, and please don't hesitate to tell us if you find any more issues.

The next patch will adress this issue and some others, but until then, know that we are working tirelessly to make Rising Islands a better game for you all.

Until next time,

 - The Lone Hero Team

notes.title: Rising Islands update 1.011 - Patch #2
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are so happy that people are now able to play and enjoy the game. To make the experience smoother we have adressed some bugs that popped up. The patch fixes are:

- Fixed a bug where skipping a cutscene would only pause the video.
- Fixed a bug where localization did not save properly
- Fixed potholes in world 3 where player could get stuck.

Thank you for all the continued support and feedback.

- The Lone Hero Team

notes.title: Rising Islands update 1.010 - Release update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The day is upon us when we release Rising Islands to the world. We have listened to the feedback from our early testers and these are the updates for the release build.

- Updated 2D cutscenes
- Fixed Time trial showing collectibles at end
- Fixed Time trial not showing restart option if lose cutscene is skipped
- Fixed a bug where the player could infinitely wallrun 
- Fixed checkpoints that spawned Hairo in the middle of nowhere
- Filled a hole where Hairo could get stuck in the tutorial level
- Credits fixed at the end of the game
- Minor text fixes

Thank you for all the support and feedback! 

- The Lone Hero Team

notes.title: Rising Islands coming August 2!
notes.notes:
Big news! Rising Islands will be available on Steam on August 2, 2016.

To celebrate this we have a new colorful trailer that shows more of what you can expect.

https://youtu.be/Ewm74FXvWZ0

Tell us what you think about the trailer and we hope you are as excited as we are for August! Thank you to everyone who has been supporting us, talked to us at events and played the game. You are awesome!

Also, don’t forget to add Rising Islands on your wish list on Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/452450/


-	The Lone Hero Team
